title: MerlinOption
description: A command registered with the Merlin (super-daemon) singleton via `SuperDaemonInstance.defineOption(option)`, or a row returned by a Program. Selecting the row dispatches a CustomEvent named `eventName` with `detail` = `value`, then closes the palette unless eventName is `super-daemon-run-program`. The shape of `value` is checked per known eventName below. Runtime values that JSON cannot hold (element references, functions, lit TemplateResults) appear as descriptive strings in JSON examples; scripts/validate.js accepts the real objects when validating JS source. Unknown keys are rejected so typos are caught; custom keys must start with `x-` (note: defineOption indexes every string field for search, including `x-` ones).

title.description: Primary label in the result row; used for alphabetical sort and exact-match priority boosting.

value.description: Payload dispatched as the event `detail`. Shape depends on `eventName` (see allOf below and the README event table).

eventName.description: CustomEvent dispatched on selection. Handled by super-daemon: super-daemon-element-method, super-daemon-element-click, super-daemon-run-program. Handled elsewhere: hax-super-daemon-insert-tag (HAXStore inserts a block), execute-keyboard-shortcut (haxcms-site-editor-ui runs a registered shortcut). No-op rows: disabled, super-daemon-noop. Any other name is dispatched as a plain event for your own listener.

icon.description: Icon name (`iconset:name`, e.g. `icons:save`) rendered by simple-icon-lite.

image.description: Image URL rendered instead of an icon.

textCharacter.description: Character or emoji rendered instead of an icon/image.

tags.description: Search keywords, also rendered as tag chips. defineOption() defaults it to [].

path.description: Breadcrumb-style location (e.g. `CMS/admin/seo`); searchable as a phrase and per `/` segment. defineOption() defaults it to "".

description.description: Extra searchable text. Indexed for search but not rendered in the row.

priority.description: Sort weight; lower sorts higher. An exact title match forces -10000000. Defaults to 0.

context.description: Where the option is visible: `*` (default) everywhere, or one or more context names. Common: `CMS`, `HAX`, `admin`, `logged-in`, `community`, `>` (developer mode), `/` (program list). Platform feature names (`addPage`, `uploadMedia`, `outlineDesigner`, ...) are also used as contexts so options disappear when HAXcms platform settings disable that feature. Prefer an array: a string context is matched with String.includes, i.e. by substring.

voice.description: Voice phrase pattern for the hal-9000 layer, e.g. `(toggle) dark mode` (parenthesized words optional). Falls back to `title`.

more.description: Extra detail rendered in an expandable section of the row (a lit TemplateResult at runtime). Only plain strings are added to the search index.

inline.description: Also list this option when Merlin is invoked inline (slash in an empty block, `::` token, RTE toolbar). Defaults to false.

inlineOnly.description: List this option ONLY when Merlin is invoked inline; it never appears in global browse/search. Implies `inline`, so do not set both.

hidden.description: Keep the option registered (invokable by machineName / shortcut via runProgram or waveWand) but never list it in browse/search.

externalLink.description: Render an open-in-new-window icon on the row because selecting it opens an external site.

shortcut.description: Links the option to the shared KeyboardShortcutManager registry: a registered descriptor id (e.g. `cms-save`) or an inline descriptor. defineOption() resolves it to `shortcutLabel`. Not part of the search index.

shortcutLabel.description: Keyboard hint rendered on the row (e.g. `Ctrl⇧S`, `###`). defineOption() computes it from `shortcut`, so do not set it on registered options. Rows returned by a Program are NOT passed through defineOption, so set it yourself there if you want a hint.

index.description: Search index built by defineOption() from the option's string/array fields. Never set it yourself.

^x-.description: Extension key for tool-specific data. String values are added to the search index.

^\\$comment.description: Annotation for JSON examples; not used at runtime.

target.description: Object or element whose method is called (`this`, `globalThis`, an element).

elementClickValue.description: super-daemon dispatches a synthetic click on `value.target`.

programValue.description: Handed to runProgram(); Merlin enters program mode. The WHOLE value object is also passed to the program as its second argument (`values`), so extra keys are allowed and are how a program receives data (for example `index` / `detail` in HAXStore's app-search programs).

program.description: `async (input, values) => MerlinOption[]`, re-run (debounced ~150ms) on every keystroke. A descriptive string in JSON examples.

machineName.description: Stable id so runProgram(like, context, values, 'machine-name') / waveWand can launch it without a function reference. Required for `hidden` / `inlineOnly` programs.

context.description: Command context (a single string) activated while the program runs, e.g. `CMS`, `/`, `>`. Not an array: runProgram() assigns it directly to commandContext.

placeholder.description: Search input placeholder while the program runs.

initialValue.description: `async (values) => string`; a non-empty result pre-fills the search input when the program is launched with no explicit like/search. Currently only honored when the program is launched by machineName (runProgram(null, ctx, values, 'machine-name')); selecting the row from Merlin search skips it (fix proposed in haxtheweb/webcomponents).

insertTagValue.description: Handled by HAXStore._superDaemonInsert: fills the active program target with properties.src/source/href if one is waiting, otherwise inserts through the HAX tray like a block click.

demoSchema.description: true = insert the element's first demoSchema entry.

keyboardShortcutValue.description: haxcms-site-editor-ui looks the id up in KeyboardShortcutManager and runs it.

shortcutDescriptor.description: KeyboardShortcutManager descriptor (webcomponents elements/utils/lib/keyboardShortcuts.js). `type` defaults to `binding`; `id` defaults to the binding combo (e.g. `Ctrl+Shift+S`) or `markdown-<trigger>`.

trigger.description: markdown: typed text that triggers the insert.

condition.description: JS function returning whether the binding is active.
